Winter Soldier. S to throw a bomb. H to blow up the bomb. F to grab
Loki. 2 to shoot while attacking. 3 to duplicate yourself.
Black Panther. 2 teleport. down, up and 1 at same time shoot magic
Captain America. F throw shield. S block/deflect
Groot. s to make hole. 2 to grab
Doctor Strange. E or S to teleport, Q to turn back time
Hulk. while in the air press down arrow to Hulk Smash
Max Steel. Q Turbo Strenth mode. S Turbo Speed mode. E Turbo Flight
Flash. S to stop moving. H to speed up
Bat Man. Ranged. S smoke bomb. F invisibility must stay still to use
Spider man. doulble jump to shoot grapple web into the air, arrow keys to move around. press the 2 key to shoot web at enemy
Thor. press F to Throw lighting 3.5 second cool down
Super man. f for laser eyes
Flash. down to stop moving. 2 to speed up
The Green Arrow. 2 to shoot. down to duck. 5 to grapple hook
Rocket. Q and E to change guns (have ammo). S to shoot big beam
Hawkeye. f to shoot power arrow, changes every time.
Vision. 2 to go ghost. 3 to shoot laser
War Machine. 2 for rockets. shoot fast then relode, automaticly.
Ant Man. F to throw shrink/grow disc, random. s to shrink and summon ants.
